title: Patch: the daily board holds "End turn automatically" until the mulligan is over, so the other player's keep never fails as stale
thread:
**Issue #3841 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3841: Patch: the daily board holds "End turn automatically" until the mulligan is over, so the other player's keep never fails as stale
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

A follow-up to daily games (#3727, merged in #3762), found in its review and left out of it. Part of the tracker #3726.

### What happens

During a daily game's mulligan both players hold the move at once (R3727002). The board sends the player's saved "End turn automatically" setting (`setAutoEndTurn`, R345) as soon as the player holds the move, which in the mulligan is at once. That adds a row to the game's log. If the other player sends their keep or mulligan at the same moment, theirs fails as `409 stale`: the board rereads quietly, and that player has to click again.

- [`apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx:101`](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/1964004112/apps/web/src/daily/DailyBoard.tsx#L100-L137): the held `setAutoEndTurn`, sent once `hasMove` is true.
- [`crates/shared/src/host/daily.rs:112`](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/1964004112/crates/shared/src/host/daily.rs#L112) (`daily_holders`): both seats hold the move during the mulligan.

### What should happen

One player's saved setting never makes the other player's mulligan answer fail. The setting still reaches the game in time for the first turn.

### How to reproduce

Two accounts, one with "End turn automatically" set differently from the game's default. Open a fresh daily game's board on both at once; while the first board's `setAutoEndTurn` is in flight, keep the hand on the second. The second's keep answers `409 stale`, and it must click again.

### Fix

In `DailyBoard`, also hold `setAutoEndTurn` until the mulligan is over, then send it as it does now. (The server-side alternative, refusing `setAutoEndTurn` during the mulligan in `daily_allows`, `crates/shared/src/host/daily.rs:176`, changes a rule and would need a ruling note, so prefer the web fix.) Add a `DailyBoard.test.tsx` case that fails without it: during the mulligan the board sends no `setAutoEndTurn`, and sends it once the mulligan is over.
```
